annotation_overview: segmentation masks where created manually by scientific experts using Napari
annotation_method: A supervised algorithm (Cellpose) was utilized to produce a first coarse annotation of nuclear contours. Then, a disease expert curated all annotations by editing, adding, or removing polygons in napari. Finally, an expert pathologist revised all image annotations and a final version of the annotations was curated.
